description.html: The Chicos CH-22008 is a resin decoration shaped like the wreck of an old sailing ship. The hull is broken and tilted, with a row of small windows along the side, broken masts and a bow rising above the base. The masts and the rocks under the ship are painted moss green, while the brown wood tones and a blue stripe on the hull give the wreck a vivid but weathered look.

In the lower part of the hull there is an arched opening through which fish can swim inside the ship. Small fish, shrimp and species that look for shade during the day like to use this kind of hide. At 21.5 x 9 x 12 cm, the ship is eye-catching enough for a small aquarium and nicely fills the foreground or midground of a larger one.

Before placing the wreck, rinse it with lukewarm water, without detergent. The flat base stands steadily on gravel or sand, and you can also bury it slightly so the ship looks as if it has sunk into the bottom. Turn the opening in the hull toward the front glass so you can watch fish swim in and out. Remove algae from the surface with a soft brush during regular aquarium maintenance.
